author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Does Adam Savage think it was easier to buy materials for MythBusters in the United States (vs. internationally?) How would Adam build a low-cost Apollo-inspired helmet today? Are there any props Adam would like to make from Predator Badlands? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members richardduffy, kennydavis and gimmebuilds, whom we thank for their support!

02:03 Helmet
06:14 Predator Badlands
